Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_debugLog_: Write ExtractionMapUtils Lua diagnostics to client and server logs, including NPC discovery, right-click matching and dialogue requests. Disabled by default. Enable on the server and reconnect clients before troubleshooting.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_ForceMapR: Reveal the world map and minimap regardless of the base map settings. In multiplayer, revealed areas are also recorded on the server. Minimap zoom and visibility follow normal game controls. Disabling this option does not erase areas already revealed.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_RelocateO: Relocate to lobby on every login

Requires Enable lobby. Relocate closed-lobby logins and known arrivals from another server to the configured lobby. After release, invalid saved positions can also be rescued. Death respawns use the separate Relocate to lobby after death setting. Configure Lobby X/Y first.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyEnab: Enable military fence construction, protection against disassembly in the lobby, release commands and scheduled perimeter removal. Relocation on login also requires its own setting. Restart the server and reconnect clients after changes. Disabling this option stops lobby control but does not remove fences already saved in the world.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_ZombieMon: Add 1 to 10 Base.Money items to zombie corpses after server-confirmed kills by connected players. Independent of the lobby setting. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyX_to: X coordinate of the world tile. A value of -1 leaves the lobby unconfigured and skips relocation on login.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyY_to: Y coordinate of the world tile. A value of -1 leaves the lobby unconfigured and skips relocation on login.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyZ_to: Floor coordinate in the world. A value of 0 is ground level. Choose a tile with a valid floor at this height.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyX1_t: First perimeter corner X. Restart after changing bounds. Existing saved layouts require removal/migration before moving the perimeter.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyY1_t: First perimeter corner Y. Corners are normalized automatically.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyX2_t: Second perimeter corner X. Area must be at least seven tiles wide and high; perimeter limit is 4096 edges.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyY2_t: Second perimeter corner Y. Fences and building restrictions use this same area. Login coordinates remain separate.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyFenc: Floor for the fence and all lobby building restrictions. Ground level is 0. Independent of the login destination floor.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyDoor: Default 3. Set 0 for a fully enclosed operation lobby. Set 1 to 3 for permanent lobbies: players can open and close these doors at any time. Protection rules still apply. Restart after changes.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyFenc: Enabled by default. Build and maintain the perimeter. Building restrictions work independently. Disabling does not remove existing saved fences.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_LobbyBloc: Enabled by default. Block new builds inside the lobby, including multi-tile entities that overlap its bounds.
Enabled by default. Block multistage wall/building upgrades in the lobby. Independent of new construction.
Enabled by default. Block dismantling and scrapping world objects in the lobby. Inventory items are unaffected.
Lobby: block furniture and floor pickup
Enabled by default. Block picking up furniture and floor tiles inside the lobby. Rotation remains available.
Enabled by default. Block native sledgehammer destruction of world objects in the lobby.
Enabled by default. Block shoveling ground material inside the lobby.
Sandbox_ApocExtractionMapUtils_RelocateO: Disabled by default. After respawning in the same server session, override the safehouse or map/mod spawn and move to the configured lobby, even during an operation. Independent of login/server-transfer relocation. Requires Enable lobby and valid Lobby X/Y/Z. Update the 42.21.0 server patch for authoritative multiplayer respawn detection.
